programme.title: China's Greatest Treasures
programme.desc: Compelling documentary series in which host, BBC Art Critic Alastair Sooke, embarks on an adventure of a lifetime, travelling through modern day China to examine how China's most important historic artefacts housed in museum collections across the country still influence and define the nation today. programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Best friends and cadets-in-training Swift, Penny, Rod, and Brody congregate at Top Wing Academy, where they learn what it takes to gain their wings and become rescue birds on Big Swirl Island. Swift is a blue jay and the fastest pilot at the academy; Penny, the only female in the group, is a penguin, and she is an expert at undersea life; Brody is a puffin who takes a more land approach, and Rod is a rooster who is ready to fly around Big Swirl Island in his all-terrain vehicle. The four friends are joined by their mentor Speedy, who helps the cadets on their different missions. "Top Wing" focuses on the importance of teamwork and the ability to successfully solve problems.

programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Добровольцы
programme.desc: В 2014 году "Лысый" бросил учёбу в польском университете и вернулся, чтобы защищать Украину. Сначала - добровольческий батальон "Госпитальеры", где он эвакуировал раненых с передовой. После 2015 года он вернулся к мирной жизни, но в 2022-м снова пошёл на фронт - теперь уже в десантно-штурмовые войска. Он получил ранение, но даже после этого не остановился: продолжает работать, адаптироваться к жизни и помогать Украине приближать победу.

programme.title: Внутри России: предатели и герои
programme.desc: Двое российских кинематографистов, несмотря на огромный риск, снимали материал о том, какие последствия имело для России вторжение в Украину. Тысячи людей бежали из страны. Тем, кто остался, пришлось делать выбор: выступать против войны, поддерживать ее или молчать.

programme.title: Первые последние выборы
programme.desc: Впервые президентскую присягу директор совхоза Александр Лукашенко принес 20 июля 1994 года, став первым и до сегодняшнего дня единственным президентом суверенной Беларуси. Многие эксперты и политологи считают выборы 1994 года первыми и последними честными выборами в стране. Все последующие президентские кампании проходили с нарушениями международных норм и обязательств Беларуси перед ОБСЕ. История трансформации Лукашенко из популиста в диктатора - в документальном фильме "Последние первые выборы".

programme.title: Археология
programme.desc: Диалоги о вечных вопросах российской жизни и болевых точках повседневности, о войне и мире. Эти темы Сергей Медведев и его гости обсуждают в программе \"Археология\".

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: Съёмочная группа программы "Ждем в гости" побывала в селе Алексеевка муниципалитета Тетри-Цкаро (Грузия), чтобы рассказать об одной замечательной семье, которая удивила самых искушенных ценителей легендарного виски. Не используя никаких шотландских или ирландских классических технологий, здесь для получения виски используют традиционный глиняный кувшин квеври, в котором грузины уже более 8000 лет производят вино.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Алые паруса
programme.desc: Каждый год в конце июня Санкт-Петербург становится местом главного праздника страны для десятков тысяч выпускников. "Алые паруса" - это момент прощания с детством и торжественного вступления во взрослую жизнь. Наш фильм получает редкий доступ к поколению, которое взрослеет в эпоху кардинальных перемен. Мы поговорим с молодыми россиянами о том, как они видят своё будущее, какие возможности и ограничения предлагает им сегодняшняя Россия, как они относятся к власти, личным свободам и войне в Украине, начавшейся в их раннем подростковом возрасте. Некоторые из них уже стоят перед реальной перспективой призыва. Через живые интервью на фоне самого яркого праздника России фильм раскрывает надежды, страхи и мечты поколения на важнейшем жизненном рубеже. Фильм создан телеканалом OstWest.

programme.title: Внутри России: предатели и герои
programme.desc: Двое российских кинематографистов, несмотря на огромный риск, снимали материал о том, какие последствия имело для России вторжение в Украину. Тысячи людей бежали из страны. Тем, кто остался, пришлось делать выбор: выступать против войны, поддерживать ее или молчать.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Интервью
programme.desc: Александр Баунов - политолог, старший научный сотрудник Берлинского центра Карнеги по изучению России и Евразии и автор книги "Конец режима". Документальный сериал по мотивам книги вышел на канале "Настоящее время", и сейчас сериал показывают в том числе в кинотеатрах в Европе. Ведущий Настоящего времени Алексей Александров встретился с Бауновым в Праге, чтобы поговорить о том, на какую из других автократий похожа современная Россия, почему Путин все больше отрывается от России и российских элит, что это говорит о будущем репрессий в стране, и насколько близок конец режима.

programme.title: Сибириада
programme.desc: Путин поручил рассмотреть постройку Северо-Сибирской железной дороги. Путь из Нижневартовска должен разгрузить Транссиб. К подобным масштабным проектам многие относятся скептически. К примеру, за 12 лет так и не была построена дорога Кызыл - Курагино. Железнодорожная ветка должна была связать Тыву с Транссибом. Кто-то надеялся на экономическое развитие с появлением этой дороги. Кто-то считает, что она может разрушить уникальную природу края. Так или иначе, железная дорога до сих пор не построена, и в ближайшее время это вряд ли произойдет. А значит, жизнь людей в этих местах тоже не изменится.

programme.title: Как у них получилось?
programme.desc: Шоу журналиста Александра Мурашева, в котором он НЕ говорит о "прекрасной России будущего" в теории. Александр Мурашев отправляется в страны, где когда-то можно было найти самые болезненные для России проблемы: от свалок размером с города до коррупции и тюремной системы. И выясняет как у них получилось эти проблемы решить. В первой части сезона вместе с Александром Мурашевым вы побываете в Японии, Сингапуре, Тайване и Южной Корее.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Это фильмы о людях, живущих в Латвии, Литве и Эстонии. Они говорят на разных языках, но все — об одном и том же: о том, что волнует, огорчает или радует каждого из нас. Мы не делим жизнь на политику и всё остальное — мы просто говорим о самом важном.

programme.title: DW.#вТРЕНДde
programme.desc: Интервью с журналисткой Ксенией Лученко.

programme.title: Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Здесь выращивают больше всего попкорна в стране. Из старых машин сооружают новое чудо света. Знают, как разговаривать с коровами и беречь каждый сантиметр плодородных земель. Это настоящая американская глубинка. Родина миллиардера Уоррена Баффета, который до сих пор не променял штат ни на какой другой. Небраска - скромная, но отнюдь не безликая. Она умеет удивлять самыми простыми и бытовыми вещами.

programme.title: Интервью
programme.desc: Варвара Шмыкова - актриса, получившая широкую известность после роли в сериале "Чики". Из-за высказываний в поддержку Алексея Навального она лишилась ролей в фильмах и спектаклях, а в 2022 году заняла жесткую антивоенную позицию и уехала из России. Шмыкова снялась в фильме Андрея Звягинцева "Минотавр", который получил Гран-при Каннского фестиваля. Настоящее Время поговорило с актрисой о "Минотавре", Звягинцеве и его победной речи в Каннах, войне, государственной машине, современном российском кино и съемках в европейских картинах.

programme.title: Свидетели Путина
programme.desc: События фильма начинаются 31 декабря 1999 года, когда россиянам представили их нового президента. Фильм основан на уникальных и строго документальных свидетельствах истинных причин и последствий операции "преемник", в результате которой россия оказалась с президентом, который правит страной до сих пор. Главными героями фильма являются Михаил Горбачев, Борис Ельцин, Владимир Путин и русский народ, который как всегда безмолвствует.

programme.title: Pandikunnide Ameerika seiklus
programme.desc: Rick, Corey ja Chum teevad suuri tehinguid kõige väiksemas osariigis! Providence'is Rhode Islandil satuvad poisid muskelautode kollektsioonile, vaatavad läbi John Adamsi kirjutatud haruldase raamatu ja võtavad sihikule harpuunipüstoli.

programme.title: Pandikunnide Ameerika seiklus
programme.desc: Rick, Corey ja Chum lähevad teele, et otsida aardeid Tampas Floridas. Ekspertidest koosneva meeskonna juhtimisel rüüstavad poisid kõike alates Pokemoni kaartidest kuni Steve McQueeni mootorrattani, lootes päikeselises osariigis laineid lüüa.

programme.title: Iidsed tulnukad
programme.desc: Alates 500-tonnisest kivist, mis arvatavasti kujutab endast iidset UFO-t, kuni hiiglaslike kujudeni, mis väidetavalt on loodud arenenud tehnoloogia abil - kas need erakordsed püstised kivid võivad anda tunnistust maaväliste olendite külaskäigust?

programme.title: Oak Islandi needus
programme.desc: Nova Scotia ranniku lähedal paikneb väike saar, mis peidab endas mõistatuslikku saladust. 18. sajandil märgati seal öösiti kummalisi tulesid.

programme.title: Iidsed tulnukad
programme.desc: Asteegid rajasid ühe maailma võimsama ja kardetuma impeeriumi ning nad väitsid, et neid juhib terve hulk jumalaid. Kas nende uskumatu võimuletõusu lugu võib paljastada maavälise sekkumise ajaloo Meso-Ameerikas?

programme.title: Pandikunnid

programme.title: Conviction
programme.desc: Sam Rockwell, Hilary Swank and Melissa Leo star in Tony Goldwyn's fact-based drama. When Kenny Waters (Rockwell) is jailed for murder, his elder sister Betty Anne (Swank) is incredulous. She knows that he has an unruly streak to his character and that his temper occasionally flares violently, but she's certain he's not capable of the brutal murder of an old woman. Nancy Taylor (Leo), the officer in charge of the case, sees things very differently and, despite there being only the slimmest of circumstantial evidence and hearsay to link Kenny to the murder, he is charged and subsequently found guilty. However, over the course of the following decade, advances in forensics and Betty Anne's transformation, through hard study, into a campaigning lawyer combine to offer Kenny hope. As long as the police kept all the evidence and records relating to his case... With Minnie Driver and Juliette Lewis. Film4 premiere.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: The Summer We Live
programme.desc: Year 1998. Isabel, a journalism student, is forced to do her internship in the newspaper of a small Galician coastal town in order to finish her degree. When she arrives, she wants to start investigating as soon as possible, to demonstrate everything she has learned in order to become a real journalist. But the position she is assigned is the last one she expected: the writing and management of the obituaries that reach the newsroom. But this, which might seem boring at first, becomes the door to an investigation that will take her through different parts of the Spanish geography in search of an impossible love story.

programme.title: My Friend from the Park
programme.desc: Liz, a new mother, meets Rosa and they end up becoming good friends. However, their friendship takes an unexpected turn as Liz is pulled into a life of crime and instability.

programme.title: The Graduate
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning comedy drama. Disillusioned graduate Benjamin Braddock is urged by his family to enter a business career and settle down after college, but instead he finds himself seduced by Mrs Robinson, a friend of his parents. He tries to extricate himself from the affair when he falls in love with Mrs Robinson's daughter, but finds that his own actions may have sealed his fate. Featuring the music of Simon and Garfunkel.

programme.title: Hannes
programme.desc: Born at the same place, on the same day, Hannes and Moritz grow up to be inseparable friends. But one day a tragic motorcycle accident will change their lives forever, leaving Hannes in a coma with a slim chance of recovery. Moritz refuses to give up on his friend and puts his own life aside to ensure Hannes is always loved and surrounded by life and laughter. Trying to stand his ground, Moritz will then embark on an inspiring and life-changing journey, realizing that every day is worth celebrating and proving their friendship is stronger than ever.

programme.title: Neem Me Mee
programme.desc: Six people over seventy are at a turning point in their lives. Without knowing each other, they go on a journey together.

programme.title: The Nannies
programme.desc: Angèle, a thirty-something from Ivory Coast, always cope thanks to the gift of gab and audacity. To escape from a bunch of dangerous criminals, she becomes a nanny in the uptown Paris, hired by Hélène, the single mom of eight years old Arthur. Discovering the work conditions of her colleagues, she decides to stand up for their rights, thanks to a young lawyer who will quickly fall for her.

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: A woman meets the love of her life on her bachelorette night, but the weekend they spend together is the beginning of the end.

programme.title: All Because of the Cat
programme.desc: On the cusp of 50, a woman can't stand anything any more; the only person who finds favour in her eyes - and is her only ally - is her cat Max.

programme.title: Slumdog Millionaire
programme.desc: Danny Boyle's multi-Oscar-winning drama opens with Jamal Malik (Dev Patel), a call centre chaiwallah (tea seller), on the verge of winning 20 million rupees on the Indian version of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?. But the show's host (Anil Kapoor) thinks Jamal's cheating and hands him to the police to beat the truth out of him. Jamal tells them he knows the answers because they relate to significant episodes in his life, which are then told in flashback. It's the tale of a seemingly inseparable friendship between Jamal, his brother Salim and their friend Latika, which is ultimately soured by Salim's actions. But Jamal's appearance on the TV quiz offers a chance of reconciliation, as well as great riches. Patel is outstanding in his role, with Jamal also being played at different stages of his life by Tanay Hemant Chheda and Ayush Mahesh Khedekar. Madhur Mittal, Ashutosh Lobo Gajiwala and Azharuddin Mohammed Ismail play Salim; with Frieda Pinto, Tanvi Ganesh Lonkar and Rubina Ali as Latika. In English, and Hindi with English subtitles. This screening of Slumdog Millionaire is in commemoration of Irrfan Khan who died April 29th aged just 53.

programme.title: A Bronx Tale
programme.desc: Drama set in 1960s New York about an Italian American boy surrounded by conflicting influences while growing up in the Bronx. The boy's father is almost powerless to do anything when his son becomes increasingly corrupted by a neighbourhood gangster. The two father figures - one hard-working and loving, the other involved in dangerous, underworld activities - exert conflicting pressures and beliefs.

programme.title: Year Of the Fox
programme.desc: Ivy is a teenager navigating Aspen's party scene amidst her adoptive parents' divorce. As she watches her community provide cover for predatory behavior, Ivy struggles to find her path.

programme.title: Initials SG
programme.desc: "Struggling actor" is a euphemism for 50-year-old suave, nevertheless professionally washed-up Argentinian Sergio Garces, who is still reminiscing about a long-forgotten cover album of Serge Gainsbourg's songs he had recorded in his youth. To him, the two of them share not only a slight resemblance and common initials, but the singer's enticing aura as well. As the World Cup final between Argentina and Germany is closing in, plunging Buenos Aires in anticipation frenzy, Sergio's streak of ridiculously bad luck is about to reach a record-high. A sui generis blend of offbeat dramedy, crime caper and surreal dark comedy, set against a backdrop of dead-serious sarcasm.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Miami
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Miami is a documentary reality series following dedicated animal control officers as they provide a valuable service to the animals of Miami-Dade County. Keeping a close eye on the region's creatures, both wild and domesticated, the control officers visit various locations to investigate reports of injured or sick animals, and deplorable cases of animal cruelty, ensuring they are provided with the welfare they deserve. The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: Preparations for winter are underway in Alaska's Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. In less than three weeks, the refuge will be covered in snow, making transport and hunting near impossible. Bob prepares his gear for the first hunt of the season but runs into trouble when his boat engine malfunctions. Heimo spots a gigantic bull moose - the one animal that can provide enough meat for himself and his wife throughout the entire winter. After tracking the animal to a gravel bar, Heimo deploys his signature moose call to draw it out into the open. Later, a fourth family - Tyler and Ashley Selden - arrive at their cabin to find it flooded by a rising river. After working to catch nearly 400 salmon, the young couple is forced to go on the offensive after a bear ransacks their fish pile and threatens the only means of keeping their dog team fed through winter.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: Life at Vet University

Watch the students as they meander their perpetual studies and put their learning into practice, growing both as people and professionals during the intense, consuming course.

Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

Find out why moths are attracted to flames, why turtles cry, why sea otters bond with stones, and why dogs wag their tails.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Sharkwrecked: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Paul de Gelder and James Glancy bail out of an aircraft at 3500-ft to experience what it's like to crash land into some of the world's most remote and shark-infested waters.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Meet the Penguins
programme.desc: Meet the Penguins is a documentary that follows the team of the Sancob Seabird Hospital in Cape Town, as they rescue penguins in need of help they encounter on the coast. These experts and volunteers give medical treatment, feed and support the incredible and vulnerable creatures, as they get ready to go back into the wild. Even when the odds are stacked the staff is dedicated to help the penguins get back on their feet. Meet the adorable characters of the penguins, each with a story of their own and a distinct personality.

programme.title: Meet the Orangutans
programme.desc: Meet the Orangutans is a window into the extraordinary daily drama of the world's oldest Orangutan Sanctuary. From babies being bottle-fed and wearing nappies, to teenagers being taught how to climb trees, and wounded Orangutans arriving at the sanctuary needing urgent veterinary care, there is never a dull moment. The human carers, run by eccentric Brit Sue Sheward, are every bit as colourful too, and the jury's still out on who rules the roost - the staff or the apes.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine heads to Costa Mesa, California, to help turn around the struggling Filomena's Italian Kitchen and Market. Despite a clean kitchen, an organized dining room and allegedly good food, the fiery owner, Linda, hasn't been able to pay herself one dime since the restaurant opened. Before Robert can do anything else, he first has to figure out the real problem with this restaurant and why it's in trouble.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.title: Cupcake Championship

Each of these contestants are undoubtedly talented cupcake designers, but there can only be one winner, and the heat is on to showcase their artistry and flair when it comes to baking these little sweet treats. Hosted by Kardea Brown, the show give the bakers new challenges to complete in each episode, with the poorest performing contestant eliminated at each stage of the competition, resulting in a final showdown between the very best.

programme.title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
programme.desc: Each chef is assigned an element - earth, air, fire, water, or space - and must craft a large-format dessert with a decorative sugar element.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

After each episode the worst performing baker is removed from the camp and the remaining contestants soldier on. From classic campsite s'mores to preparing a wedding cake outdoors, the bakers have their culinary clout tested like never before.

programme.title: Ciao House

programme.title: Ghost Loop
programme.desc: Follow a team of highly specialized paranormal experts, who help both the living and the dead and focus on a distinct type of haunting - ''ghost loop'', which happens when paranormal entities terrorize the living through endless and repetitive supernatural cycles, manifesting again and again in the same location. In each episode, paranormal investigator and medium Sean Austin, empath Kris Star, researcher and tech advisor Chris Califf, design specialist Eric Vitale, and tech support Matt Lytle, examine and research their client's property and history. Then, they formulate a plan they believe will help stop the haunting - whether it's building a 1900s-era train compartment, replicating a tavern from the 1850s, or constructing a 19th century baby's nursery. The team uses emotionally charged settings to draw out the entities in hopes that it will release the energy and break the loop once and for all.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Border Control Sweden
programme.desc: The border control is on a party cruise looking for drugs, and it doesn't take long before Casper the dog detects something.

programme.title: Outback Truckers
programme.desc: Follow a small group of men and women who drive the largest trucks on Earth along the toughest roads and loneliest highways in Australian Outback. These brave people must go on very long drives as they battle fire, flood and lots of mud to make their deadlines and deliver their goods. Tune in and enjoy the beautiful scenery, ingenious roadside repairs, and interesting characters.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. Only top racers participate in the competition, they want to appear and stay at the A-list, everything they have to do is to try to squeeze as much performance out of their vehicles as possible.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Expedition Unknown chronicles the adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates iconic mysteries across the globe. Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. Josh Gates is an adventurer and avid explorer with a unique brand of humor and passion for off-the-map excursions.

programme.title: Lost Monster Files
programme.desc: The team investigates a stranger-than-fiction murder mystery involving the Wildman of Minnesota; known as the Ice Man, its body became a sideshow attraction that Sanderson examined himself before it mysteriously disappeared.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, the couple quickly get to know each other -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude will serve them well.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: Virgins
programme.desc: After years of missed connections and dating horror stories, these late bloomers are done playing it safe. They're stepping outside their comfort zones and taking big swings to finally go all the way, emotionally and physically. From navigating awkward first dates to exploring a bondage class and working with an intimacy partner they're putting it all on the line in hopes of finally sealing the deal.

programme.title: Match Me Abroad
programme.desc: After failing to find a soulmate in the US, Americans take the search overseas for a chance at happiness. Expert matchmakers pull out all the stops to connect these hopeful romantics to their one true love.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: The Blended Bunch
programme.desc: What started with tragedy, manifested into a once in a lifetime love story. Before meeting, Erica, a mother of 7, lost her husband to cancer and Spencer, a father of 4, lost his wife in a fatal car crash. Their worlds were completely shattered until they serendipitously met in an online widower support group. Finding love almost immediately, Erica and Spencer exchanged vows and were married after just 13 months. The series centers on their large, newly blended family that will face all kinds of challenges as they merge 11 children under one roof and adjust to a new life in Utah.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: Little Singles
programme.desc: A group of young, single little people friend take the vacation of a lifetime in Palm Springs, but a secret threatens to tear the group apart.

programme.title: Addicted To Marriage
programme.desc: Addicted to Marriage follows the lives of four intriguing women who love to get married. Meet Monette, Shae, Amy, and Kecia, who collectively have been down the aisle a total of 20 times! Each marriage enthusiast is ready to say "I do" again, but are the men in their lives ready? Some of the women know exactly what they want in a future marriage while others struggle with their pasts. One of the brides-to-be has a list she refers to as the 'Triple A': attention, affection and appreciation whereas others grapple with revealing how many times they've said 'I do' because of their lurking insecurities of potentially failing at yet another marriage. The women know they trust quickly and love hard but the relationship highs are often met with intense drama and scrutiny by the men they love. Will their willingness for a happy ending with Prince Charming push the men in their life away or will they finally have the happily ever after they have been longing for?

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé UK
programme.desc: Charlotte wants to settle down and hopes that Johan can provide stability, and after struggling with love, Jamie believes Kathleen might be the one.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: The Bad Foot Clinic
programme.desc: Severe fungal foot and nail infections, warts, corns, webbed toes, bunions and verrucas are all in a day's work for leading podiatrist Marion Yau and her GP husband Dr Kenny. Together, they tackle extreme and debilitating foot conditions.

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: As global warming heads to 2 degrees Celsius, heat waves are on the rise, as well as droughts, fires and floods. Some cities are seeing the highest monthly temperatures in history. Ocean water is heating up, aquatic life is migrating north to more comfortable temperatures, impacting ocean-based industries such as lobster fishing. Heat blobs - flash heat waves in the ocean - are leading to toxic levels of algae and plankton. This episode tells first-hand stories of an east coast fishing community facing the end of an industry and an epic heat wave in Montreal..

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: The air we breathe is in jeopardy with an increase in greenhouse gases, both polluting the air and trapping pollution under the smog. Industrial pollution leading to an airpocalypse is just the start. Methane frozen in permafrost is being released as the northern ice melts. And an increase in carbon dioxide - food for plants - means pollen is also on the rise. This episode explores the various causes of our compromised air..

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Supercar Megabuild
programme.desc: British car builders, Shane Lynch and Dan Baruffo are on a mission to make a drag racing Jaguar that can compliment one of the most celebrated aeroplanes of all time, the Supermarine Spitfire. But with a high-end client in California, a project demanding perfection, and one of their tightest deadlines ever, the boys are forced to defy the boss and make their car in Mexico. It's a race against time to see if the drag Jag will ever see the light of day.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: The average adult spends more than 220,000 hours - or roughly 25 years - in bed sleeping. That's one third of your life spent in slumber! But what exactly is sleep? Why do you spend so much of your time doing it? And what happens to your brain and body if you don't get a full night's rest? In what could be our most ambitious Brain Games experiment ever, we keep 3 volunteers awake for 36 hours in order to test the effects of sleep deprivation on human performance. Join them in our special Sleep Lab, and play along as we put them through a battery of physical and mental tests. Will their scores hold up, or will the lack of "Z's" cause them to crash? Who will make it through the sleepless marathon - the young math tutor Taylor, our burly plumber John, or Melissa, an entrepreneur and mother of four? You're going to want to stay up for this special episode… of Brain Games.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Making motoring dreams come true for a fifth season Car SOS is back, and this time it's bigger and better than ever. Everyone's favourite petrol heads Fuzz Townshend and Tim Shaw continue their mission to seek out classic cars with deserving owners. Using all their guile and restoration knowledge their aim is to sneak away clapped out classics without their owners knowing then in a blizzard of grease and grime and hard graft get the much loved motors back where they deserve to be, on the road. In this series the boys take on their biggest challenges ever. Chronic rust, hard to find parts and broken engines test the boys to their limits. British classics, Italian roadsters, German grand tourers and French hot hatches from across seven decades of motoring history make the most astonishing line-up Car SOS has ever had, and, for their lucky owners the surprise they will never forget.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Dive into the awe-inspiring world of Dutch engineering, where human ingenuity meets the relentless power of nature. From a remarkable sideways ship launch, to the nation's largest flood barrier, each stop reveals a story of engineering innovation. Then, step back in time to uncover the ingenious, water management secrets hidden within the iconic windmills of Kinderdijk.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Embark on a thrilling journey through Germany's greatest feats of engineering. From the awe-inspiring technology that's allowing engineers to build rail lines 40m below Munich city centre, to the secrets of a record breaking swing bridge across the river Ems. Marvel at twin ship lifts that carry cargo vessels 40m in the air and step back in time to visit restoration work at the world's tallest church.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: A fisherman's tip leads Air and Marine agents in the U.S. Virgin Islands to over 80 kilos of cocaine washed ashore on a public beach. Two fishing vessels are intercepted between the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico, suspected of smuggling drugs. Agents from the Fajardo unit patrol remote trails showing signs of drug trafficking routes.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. Handmade mats include additional handiwork: 100's of bags of cocaine. A student on vacation is carrying more than keepsakes: a hidden compartment hides cocaine. A Latvian carrier wants to cooperate. Cocaine hidden inside a wooden sculpture of Jesus Christ. Police listen in as a carrier takes a call from his contact.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. Two Ukrainian passengers are caught with cocaine. And one may have tricked the other. Police will need a translator to sort it out. A couple celebrating their anniversary may be taking home more than just memories. Customs find more than 130,000 euros hidden in the carry-on of an arriving passenger and move in to investigate.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Tsunami: Race Against Time
programme.desc: The tsunami hits Sri Lanka. Over 1000 miles from the earthquake's epicenter, waves wreck a train and destroy coastal cities. Doctors fight to save every life they can. As disaster spreads across the entire Indian Ocean, journalists race to break the news to the world, and people wake up to the devastating reality that their loved ones have been swept away.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: Two weeks after the explosion, Soviet authorities race to stop a molten nuclear core from poisoning the water table, and clear deadly radioactive fallout across a 30km exclusion zone. Through the summer of 1986, hundreds of thousands of conscripts and volunteers answer the government's call, to brave lethal radiation levels and build a giant concrete sarcophagus around the destroyed reactor. Meanwhile in Vienna, after months of speculation, the world's nuclear experts gather to hear the Soviet account of what caused the catastrophe. Is Gorbachev's promise of Glasnost finally revealing the truth from behind the Iron Curtain? Or could this be the Soviet's biggest cover up yet? Episode Three uncovers the extraordinary battle to build the most perilous construction project in history told by those who those who were there 40 years ago.

programme.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
programme.desc: Three days into the flood, rescue operations continue around the clock. Thousands remain trapped, as the government struggles to coordinate a rescue effort. Inside the Superdome, stories of resilience and survival emerge above the sometimes-horrific conditions. Meanwhile, media coverage shifts to emphasize disorder, focusing on looting rather than the thousands still stranded.

programme.title: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America
programme.desc: President Clinton arrives in Oklahoma as grieving families come together to remember those they have lost. The nation grapples with the reality that the bomber is an American veteran who shows no remorse. As the trial begins, the government seeks the death penalty for the worst domestic terrorist attack in U.S. history.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Meet the bada#$ queens of ancient Egypt as archeologists read between the hieroglyphs to find the true stories of Cleopatra and Hatshepsut. Of all the hidden mysteries of Egypt, the lives of these queens who would be king are among the most compelling. Immensely powerful, they created larger-than-life legends that have withstood the test of time. Now, archeologists seek to uncover their secrets ?such as where Cleopatra is buried. Even after two millennia, a sandstorm of mystery will swirls around her life? and her story lives on.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Mummies, crocodile jaws and ram skulls reveal stories of life and death, as ancient Egypt's longing for eternal life leaves its mark in bone. Teams of archaeologists uncover remains that expose the rituals, beliefs and desires of a civilization lost to time. Advanced scans tell secrets locked inside well-preserved mummies. A tomb full of children's remains forces experts to confront a deadly chapter of the past. Crocodile jaws surface beneath a legendary temple. And over 1,000 ram skulls suggest powerful cult activity tied to Ramses II. Each discovery brings scholars closer to understanding how Egyptians worshipped and endured thousands of years ago.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Minutes before the noise curfew, a privately chartered Gulfstream III is on final approach to Aspen, Colorado amid heavy snow. And though the plane directly ahead aborts its landing due to poor visibility, AvJet N303GA emerges from the clouds, tries to line up with the single runway, and crashes—instantly claiming the lives of all 18 people on board. With no signs of mechanical failure, investigators learn the plane dropped well below minimum altitude on approach. And though a deep dive into the pilots' backgrounds reveals no red flags, the plane's wreckless trajectory begins to make sense when they look into what happened before the late takeoff from Los Angeles. Client pressure blurred the lines between safety and customer satisfaction. And as a result, the confused pilots were determined to land the plane at Aspen—in spite of the risks. Final

programme.title: Peeter Oja stand-up etendus: Eestlased - erilised inimesed
programme.desc: Peeter Oja ja stand-up teater POINT otsustasid EV 100 raames uurida inimest ja seletada humoorikas võtmes lahti eestlase igapäevaelu kombed ja uskumused. "Eestlastest võiks kirjutada, rääkida ja nalja teha kogu aeg. Eestlane on hiilgav materjal! Kuigi meid on vähe, on pilt kirju, ma ütleks isegi rikkalik. Otsustav tõukejõud eestlane avada tuli muidugi Eesti Vabariigi juubeliaastast. Kui me ei räägi sel aastal meist endist, siis millal me räägime?" küsis Oja. Loomulikult ei ole selles meeskonnas nagu meie ühiskonnaski mingit soolist võrdõiguslikkust. Kuid Birgit Kermes, Peeter Oja, Karl Kermes, Mehis Pihla annavad endast kõik, et sünniks värske, mõtlemapanev, absurdne, tõsiseltvõetav, vastuoluline, tasakaalukas ja naljakas tekst.

Reporterile omases hoogsas võtmes jõuavad ekraanile värsked uudised, elulised reportaažid, ootamatud kohtumised ja hetked, mis teevad Eesti suve eriliseks. Saatejuhid Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap hoiavad silma peal nii tõsisematel teemadel kui ka suvistel seikadel meil ja mujal maailmas.

programme.title: Motellimõrvad
programme.desc: 2020. aasta 6. septembri varajastel tundidel saab kohalik politsei hädaabikõne 32-aastaselt Brian Jemal Reddingilt. Mees nutab ja karjub, et leidis oma 16-aastase tüdruksõbra Cypress Noonani Lõuna-Carolinas Ridgelandis Forest motelli toast surnuna. Noonan oli tapetud ühe lasuga pähe ja surnukeha oli voodil istuvas asendis, mis viitas sellele, et ta ei osanud rünnakut oodata. Uurijate saabudes tekita Brian Reddingu kummaline käitumine tõsiseid kahtlusi.

programme.title: Clarksoni farm

Samal ajal toob farmielu kaasa ootamatuid väljakutseid - vasikate märgistamine, hekipügamise võistlus ja advokaatide karmid prognoosid muudavad tuleviku üha ebakindlamaks.

programme.title: Politseiakadeemia 6

programme.title: Peeglite raamat

Intrigeeritud ja mälu taastamise nimel võitlev Roy võtab appi oma endise partneri, et aidata juurdlust taaselustada. Seekord arenevad asjad hoopis teisiti. Kui moonutatud kihid kooruvad lahti, paljastavad nad keerulise valede võrgu. Roy on sunnitud silmitsi seisma kohutava reaalsusega. Kas tõesti saatis ta võlla vale mehe?

programme.title: Adolf Hitleri sõda
programme.desc: Et laiendada sakslaste eluruumi ja teha Saksamaast brittide eeskujul suur impeerium, pöörab Adolf Hitler pilgu itta, lootes vallutuste käigus vabaneda ka bolševismist ning juutidest. Ent sissetung Poolasse ja salapakt Nõukogude Liiduga paiskab maailma pikka ning verisesse sõtta.

programme.title: Adolf Hitleri sõda
programme.desc: Hitleri poolt petetud Stalin peab sakslaste vastu verist kaitsesõda, kuid okupeeritud alad laienevad. Seal viib jõhker okupatsioonipoliitika tsiviilelanike massilise tapmise, esimeste getode loomise, nälja ja hävitustööni, mida Churchill iseloomustas kuriteona, millel polegi nime. See nimi sai varsti antud - genotsiid.

programme.title: Adolf Hitleri sõda
programme.desc: Kui Hitleri väed tungivad edasi Moskva poole, jääb kogu okupatsioonivägede julmuse koorem Ukraina, Valgevene ja Poola elanike kanda. Sunnitöö, massimõrvad ja esimeste koonduslaagrite rajamine soovimatute tööstuslikuks hävitamiseks muudab pöördeliselt suhtumist algul vabastajatena tervitatud sakslastesse.

programme.title: Maailmasõda: 1914-1945
programme.desc: 1914. aasta juunis tehti esimesi samme sõja suunas, kui slaavi natsionalist Gavrilo Princip mõrvas Habsburgide majast pärit ertshertsog Franz Ferdinandi.

programme.title: Maailmasõda: 1914-1945
programme.desc: I maailmasõja ajal talusid mehed lahingut ja ekstreemseid tingimusi; tsiviilisikud tegelesid toidupuuduse ja haarangutega. Etnilise puhastuse oht tõstis pead ja noor Adolf Hitler võttis seda arvesse.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: 30 pöörast päeva

Muutes pidevalt oma identiteeti, kolides linnast linna koos oma kaitsja Henriga (Timothy Olyphant), on John alati uus poiss, kel pole mingisugust sidet oma minevikuga. Ühes Ohio väikelinnas, mida ta nüüd koduks nimetab, tabab Johni elu esimene armastus (Dianna Agron), ta avastab endas uued üllatavad võimed ning leiab sideme nendega, kes jagavad ta erakordset saatust.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Paddy ja Freddie suunduvad Borneosse, et seigelda džunglis väga haruldase ja vana autoga. Chris saab sõita maailma luksuslikuma linnamaasturi Rolls-Royce Cullinaniga. Stuudios on külas Bob Mortimer.

programme.title: Seaduse nimel
programme.desc: New Yorgi parimad politseidetektiivid ja prokurörid võitlevad linna turvalisemaks muutmise nimel. Ausus on suunav jõud juurdlusest kohtuotsuseni, mistõttu kaaluvad meeskonnad õigluse leidmise poole püüdlemisel kõiki vaatenurki. Elu ripub kaalukausil, kui detektiivid ja prokurörid New Yorgis õiglust taga ajavad.

programme.title: Malaisia
programme.desc: Uus Borneo saar pakub metsikumaid elamusi! Kas eelmise öö seiklused muudavad paaride suhteid? Tänu Tomi ja Evelini õigetele vastustele Pluss-Miinus mängus peavad Tõnu ja Helen veetma veel ühe päeva hotellitoas, oodates vastast Kaotajate Duelli. Ülejäänud kolm armastajapaari sõidavad sügavamale dzunglisse, et võistelda 40 meetri kõrgusel puulatvades asuvatel rippteedel. Kaotusvalu toob jällegi pisaraid - üks paaridest peab peale duelli mängust lahkuma - kes?

programme.title: Malaisia
programme.desc: Meie armunutel tuleb sukelduda Malaisia kaunite korallide kohal. Mängu lõpuheitluses ei hoolita, kes on mees, kes naine, et saada kätte aardelaegas, mis viib luksussviiti. Kaotajapaari ootab ees karistus - nad peavad veetma öö õues! Ees ootab kolimine ja järjekordne üllatus - uues hotellis tuleb ise süüa valmistada! Mängu on jäänud kolm paari!

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid

programme.title: Puksiiriprofid

programme.desc: Eesti menufilm. Abiturient Mattias plaanib välismaale fotograafiat õppima minna, kuid tormiline armumine hulljulgesse Hannasse lööb kõik plaanid segamini. Bipolaarse häirega Hanna tõmbab Mattiase ohtlikku sündmustekeerisesse - püüdes tüdrukut päästa, sooritab poiss kuriteo, mis ähvardab ta aastateks trellide taha viia. Karistusest pääsemiseks on ainult üks viis - teeselda ainsat psüühikahäiret, mida ta tunneb. Bipolaarsust...

programme.desc: Stephanie saab päranduseks käekella ja avastab, et sellega saab kord päevas ajas viis minutit tagasi rännata. Ta hakkab seda üha rohkem kasutama, kuid siis avastab, et ta elu ja armulugu kolleegi, Hunteriga ei laabu nii, nagu ta lootnud on.

programme.title: Toidu ABC
programme.desc: Tiim otsib kokku põnevaid fakte mõnede roogade kohta, mida britid väljast tellida armastavad. Jimmy Doherty on Tais avastamas üht kevadrullide ootamatut komponenti ja siis suundub Indiasse, kus saab teada, mis väljast tellitud karri nii maitsvaks teeb. Amanda Byram ja selgitab välja, miks tekitab mõni tass kohvi rohkem suminat kui teine ning Andi Oliver uurib, kuidas valmivad döner kebabid.

programme.title: Nigella lemmikroad
programme.desc: Nigella naudib väikest köögiturismi toiduvalikuga nii lähematelt kui ka kaugematelt maadelt. Muuhulgas valmistab ta moosiküpsiseid, granaatõunakokteili, suitsutatud lõhet musta leivaga ja Norra searibisid.

programme.title: Nigella lihtsad road
programme.desc: Nigella Lawson näitab, kuidas kokkamine võib parandada enesetunnet ja lisada elule särtsu. Esimeses osas valmistatakse muuhulgas ka väikse vimkaga avokaadoröstsaia.

programme.title: Jamie tervislikud road
programme.desc: Jamie alustab hooaega tõelise rahvalemmikuga, lihapallidega, millele järgnevad hõrgutav lõhe-rukkileivaomlett ning mõnus salat. Seejärel naudime mustikaid koos kanaga ning kirsiks tordil on tervislik magustoit.

programme.title: Eksid rannal - kehad vormi
programme.desc: Pitsarestorani omanik Mahan on lasknud taignal enda keha modelleerida ja Lydia tahab oma vana keha tagasi. Kas nad suudavad "Eksid rannal" paljastuseks oma keha muuta?

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Brittany võlub ära Jamesi, kes nõustub ka teise kohtinguga. Ruth ja Paul leiavad klapi vaatamata oma vahemaale, mõlemad ütlevad "jah". Michaeli röhitsemine ja veidrused mõjuvad Rebekah'le eemalepeletavalt ja ta keeldub teisest kohtingust. Paula reageerib üle, kui Fabien ettekandjaga suhtleb ning ta ütleb vaatamata Fabieni huvile "ei". Melissa ja Keni kohting muutub tänu kolmandale rattale ebamugavaks.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Kaksikud Adelaide ja Isabella lähevad kohtingule Ridge'i ja Mintyga. Adelaide'ile meeldib Ridge, kes aga hülgab ta ja lahkub koos Mintyga. Gina ja Craig vestlevad poliitikast ning leiavad ühiselt, et keemiat nende vahel ei ole. Inglast Willi ja särtsakat Siriat liidavad toit ja naer, mõlemad nõustuvad ka teise kohtinguga. Lee ja Ross veedavad meeldivalt aega ja tahavad ka uuesti kohtuda.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Taryni ja Nasseri ühised vaated moele ja küünelakkidele panevad mõlemat teisele "jah" ütlema. Kayla Tourette'i sündroom Harrisoni ei heiduta, mõlemad nõustuvad ka teise kohtinguga. Adamile meeldib Sarah, kes on aga pirtsakas ja segaduses. Adam ütleb "jah", Sarah "ei". Jaime'ile ei lähe peale Briani koertehullus. James kohtleb Rebeccat lugupidamatult ja kustutab lootused teiseks kohtinguks.

programme.title: Las armastus kasvab
programme.desc: Maastikuarhitekt Evie kohtab väärilist vastast uue kliendi, jäärapäise arheoloog Ryani näol. Ryani tütred on aga Eviest vaimustuses ja peatselt leiab ta end operatsiooni "Tüdruksõbra kasvatamine" ohvrina.

programme.title: Vahetusse läinud
programme.desc: Alice ja Lacey on identsed kaksikud. Väljasõidul Trinidadi ja Tobagosse ajavad Alice'i boss ja Lacey äripartner nad omavahel segi. Kuna mõlema naise jaoks on liiga palju kaalul, et eksimus paljastada, otsustavad nad lihtsalt kaasa mängida. Kui olukorrad viivad ootamatute romantiliste hetkedeni, selgub, et nad mõlemad vajavad elult midagi muud, kui nad algselt arvasid.

programme.title: Jamie tervislikud road
programme.desc: Seekord näitab Jamie ajule kasulike toitude valmistamist: plaadiroog lõhega, pošeeritud aromaatsed kanapallid ning spinati-läätsepannkoogid. Lisaks õpetab ta kiudaineid nautima oma lihtsate muna-oa filotainakeerdudega ning dekadentliku, ent tervisliku magustoiduga.

programme.title: Elu maitsed
programme.desc: Lugu staažikast kokast Eugeniest ja Dodinist, gurmeekokast, kelle juures ta viimased 20 aastat töötanud on.

programme.title: Ma näen su häält
programme.desc: Tippklassi meelelahutus võrratu saatejuhi Piret Laose juhtimisel. Saates osaleval arvajapaaril tuleb tundmatute seast eristada imelise lauluoskusega inimesed andekatest teesklejatest, kes aga üldse laulda ei oska. Arvajatele on abiks nõunike kogu, kuhu kuuluvad meelelahutaja Grete Kuld, Tallinna Linnateatri näitleja Evelin Võigemast, populaarne juutuuber ja muusik Andrei Zevakin ning räpipundi "5 MIINUST" liige Estoni Kohver. Külalisnõunikuna paneb end sel korral proovile andekas multitalent Kristel Aaslaid.

Proua Hall teeb Darrowbys jõuludeks ettevalmistusi, Siegfried ja Carmody aga naaklevad selle üle, kellest saab jõuluvana.

Endine arheoloog Judith Potts kuuleb ujuma minnes naabri krundilt lasku. Ta kahtlustab kõige halvemat ja hakkab politsei umbusust hoolimata juhtumit lahendama.

programme.desc: Forsyte & Co. tabab katastroof, mis põhjustab klientide rahalise laostumise. Soames räägib Irene'ile, et Jamesil on süda haige. Jo keeldub Louisa oma elust välja jätmast ning otsib talle suvilakoha.

programme.desc: Peregrine läheb salaja ülisalajasse teadusasutusse pärast seda, kui üks selle töötaja, kes oli ka Birdie vana sõber, leitakse avariisse sattunud autost surnuks külmununa.

programme.desc: Gwenda Halliday kolib Inglismaal oma unelmate koju. Ent maja sisustades tekib tal aina enam tunne, et on siin varem viibinud ja peale kõige muu näinud pealt ka ühe naise mõrva. Miss Marple'i abiga selgub, et Gwenda oli tõepoolest varases lapsepõlves samas majas elanud.

programme.title: Varjude org
programme.desc: Tommy Lee Royce'i abistajad reedavad ta ja haavatud mees jõuab peidupaika otsides Catherine'i majja. Seal ristuvad kahe vaenlase teed viimast korda ja koos mängitakse maha lõppvaatus.

programme.title: Elu allpool nulli
programme.desc: Sue Aikens katsetab tundras uut sõidukit ja üritab tõusta Kaviki lõunatippu, kuhu tal kunagi varem pole õnnestunud pääseda. Talve lõpus õnnestub Ricko DeWilde'il korraks Huslia loodusest vajalikke varusid otsida ja ümbruses toimuva kohta olulisi teadmisi koguda. Andy Bassich ja Denise Becker seisavad silmitsi ümberkorralduste ja ohverdustega. Hailstone'ide kalapüük lõpeb aga enne, kui saab alata.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Karumõmm Pups
programme.desc: Täna veedavad Pups ja Rita öö metsas.
